mapper.select: SELECT batch_split FROM experiment WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

SELECT br.id AS "batchRunId", b.id AS "batchId", b.batch_no AS "batchNo", (SELECT string_agg(x.e ->> 'barcode', ',' ORDER BY x.o) FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.samples) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(e, o)) AS "barcodes" FROM experiment_batch_run br JOIN experiment_batch b ON b.tenant_id = br.tenant_id AND b.id = br.batch_id WHERE br.tenant_id = #{param1} AND br.experiment_run_id = #{param2} ORDER BY br.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT x.key AS "key", x.value AS "value" FROM experiment_run r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(r.variables) AS x(key, value) WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.id = #{param2} AND jsonb_typeof(r.variables) = 'object' ORDER BY x.key

SELECT br.id AS "batchRunId", b.id AS "batchId", b.experiment_id AS "experimentId" FROM experiment_batch_run br JOIN experiment_batch b ON b.tenant_id = br.tenant_id AND b.id = br.batch_id JOIN experiment_run r ON r.tenant_id = br.tenant_id AND r.id = br.experiment_run_id WHERE br.tenant_id = #{param1} AND br.experiment_run_id = #{param2} ORDER BY br.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.experiment_id AS "experimentId", b.batch_no AS "batchNo" FROM experiment_batch b JOIN experiment e ON e.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND e.id = b.experiment_id WHERE b.tenant_id = #{param1} AND b.status = 'paused' AND e.status NOT IN ('finished', 'failed', 'aborted', 'cancelled') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM experiment_batch_run br WHERE br.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND br.batch_id = b.id) ORDER BY b.batch_no, b.experiment_id
SELECT id AS "id", batch_no AS "batchNo" FROM experiment_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY batch_no

SELECT br.experiment_run_id AS "runId", br.id AS "batchRunId", b.batch_no AS "batchNo", br.attempt_no AS "attemptNo", r.status AS "status" FROM experiment_batch_run br JOIN experiment_batch b ON b.tenant_id = br.tenant_id AND b.id = br.batch_id JOIN experiment_run r ON r.tenant_id = br.tenant_id AND r.id = br.experiment_run_id WHERE br.tenant_id = #{param1} AND b.experiment_id = #{param2} AND r.status IN ('queued', 'running', 'paused') ORDER BY br.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM experiment_batch_run br JOIN experiment_run r ON r.tenant_id = br.tenant_id AND r.id = br.experiment_run_id WHERE br.tenant_id = #{param1} AND br.batch_id = #{param2} AND (br.status = 'completed' OR r.status = 'completed')) THEN 'completed' ELSE ( SELECT COALESCE(r2.status, br2.status) FROM experiment_batch_run br2 LEFT JOIN experiment_run r2 ON r2.tenant_id = br2.tenant_id AND r2.id = br2.experiment_run_id WHERE br2.tenant_id = #{param1} AND br2.batch_id = #{param2} ORDER BY br2.attempt_no DESC, br2.id DESC LIMIT 1) END
SELECT island_id FROM experiment WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

SELECT DISTINCT es.sample_id AS "sampleId", s.barcode AS "barcode" FROM experiment_sample es JOIN experiment e ON e.id = es.experiment_id AND e.tenant_id = #{param1} JOIN sample s ON s.id = es.sample_id AND s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id WHERE es.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY es.sample_id, s.barcode

SELECT b.id AS "batchId", b.batch_no AS "batchNo", b.sample_count AS "sampleCount", b.samples::text AS "samplesJson", b.status AS "storedStatus", (SELECT string_agg(x.e ->> 'barcode', ',' ORDER BY x.o) FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.samples) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(e, o)) AS "barcodes", br.id AS "batchRunId", br.experiment_run_id AS "experimentRunId", br.attempt_no AS "attemptNo", br.status AS "attemptStatus", br.started_at AS "startedAt", br.finished_at AS "finishedAt", br.error AS "error", r.status AS "runStatus" FROM experiment_batch b LEFT JOIN experiment_batch_run br ON br.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND br.batch_id = b.id LEFT JOIN experiment_run r ON r.tenant_id = br.tenant_id AND r.id = br.experiment_run_id WHERE b.tenant_id = #{param1} AND b.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY b.batch_no, br.attempt_no
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM experiment_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO experiment_batch (tenant_id, experiment_id, batch_no, sample_count, samples, status) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}::jsonb, 'pending') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, experiment_id, batch_no) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: INSERT INTO experiment_run (tenant_id, experiment_id, status, variables) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, 'queued', #{param3}::jsonb) RETURNING id
INSERT INTO experiment_run (tenant_id, experiment_id, status) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, 'queued') RETURNING id
INSERT INTO experiment_batch_run (tenant_id, batch_id, experiment_run_id, attempt_no, status) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, 'queued') RETURNING id
INSERT INTO experiment_batch_run (tenant_id, batch_id, experiment_run_id, attempt_no, status, started_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, 'running', now()) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE experiment_batch_run br SET status = r.status, error = r.error, started_at = COALESCE(br.started_at, r.started_at), finished_at = CASE WHEN r.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'aborted', 'cancelled') THEN COALESCE(br.finished_at, now()) ELSE NULL END FROM experiment_run r WHERE br.tenant_id = #{param1} AND br.id = #{param2} AND r.tenant_id = br.tenant_id AND r.id = br.experiment_run_id
UPDATE experiment_batch_run SET status = #{param3}, error = #{param4}, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{param5}::boolean THEN now() ELSE finished_at END WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
UPDATE experiment_run SET status = 'failed', error = #{param3}, finished_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'aborted', 'cancelled')
